description: This file implements an in-memory, in-process version of a grain directory for the Orleans distributed application framework, used for testing purposes. It provides methods for lookup, registration, unregistration, and silo management of grain addresses.

classes.name: InProcessGrainDirectory
classes.description: A thread-safe, in-memory implementation of the IGrainDirectory interface for use in testing environments, managing grain address registrations.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Looks up a grain address by grain ID if the silo is not dead.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a grain address, optionally replacing a previous address.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Overload that registers a grain address without specifying a previous address.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a grain address, removing it from the directory.

methods.name: UnregisterSilos
methods.description: Removes all entries associated with specified silo addresses.
